Project management essentials

Unlimited tasks

Tasks are to-do items that show who needs to do what by when.

Unlimited projects

Projects help you organize related tasks into a single space with different views like lists, boards, or timelines so you can see the big picture.

Unlimited comments

Comments let you and your team discuss tasks directly within each task, keeping all communication centered where the work happens.

Unlimited storage, 100MB per file

Store an unlimited number of files, each up to 100MB in size, directly within Asana.

Unlimited messages

Send direct messages and have team conversations in Asana to keep discussions all in one place instead of scattered across email and chat apps.

Activity logs

Asana activity logs automatically track important changes to a task, giving teams visibility into task history and accountability.

iOS and Android mobile apps

Asana offers desktop apps for macOS and Windows for optimal performance, plus iOS and Android apps for managing work on the go.

Recurring tasks

Set up recurring tasks that automatically generate the next instance with updated due dates when you complete them.

Multi-select and bulk actions

Select multiple tasks at once to perform bulk actions like editing or deleting.

Multi-home tasks to projects

With multi-homing, you can add the same task to multiple projects and any updates to that task sync automatically across all instances.
Asana AI

AI Studio (with additional credits for purchase)

Use Asana's AI-powered no-code builder to design workflows, embed AI agents, and deploy workflows directly where teams are already working.

Smart chat (also available in Slack and MS Teams)

Chat with an AI assistant available anywhere in Asana to get answers, insights about your work, and create tasks using natural language.

Smart editor

Write better task descriptions, comments, and updates with AI-powered suggestions.

Smart fields

Have Asana AI suggest and fill in custom fields so you can set up and organize your projects faster.

Smart projects

Create projects with AI-recommended structures and templates for optimal setup.

Words to workflows

Describe the workflow you want in plain language, and Asana AI automatically creates it for you—no complex setup needed.

Smart summaries on tasks and projects

Ask Asana AI for a quick overview of recent activity in your tasks and projects so you can catch up in no time.

Smart status on projects

Let Asana AI draft status reports for you by analyzing your project data and highlighting what's on track and what needs attention

Risk reports

See project risks in one place, track their impact, and spot issues early so your team can stay ahead and keep work moving smoothly.

Smart status on portfolios and goals

AI does the heavy lifting by analyzing your project data to create status summaries across all your work, giving you instant insights without the extra effort.

Smart summaries on portfolios

Skip the manual work—AI pulls key information from across your projects to create helpful summaries, so you can quickly understand what's working and what needs attention.

Smart goals

AI extracts key insights from your project tasks and data to deliver actionable portfolio overviews, helping you spot trends and make faster decisions.

Privacy and security

SOC 2 Type II

Asana works with independent third-party auditors to attest to our control effectiveness on an annual basis

Multi-factor authentication

Enforce two-factor authentication for domain members and guests

256-bit encryption at rest and in-transit

Data is encrypted in transit and at rest

Cross regional backups

Data is automatically backed up to a recovery location to maintain availability in the event of an outage

Data deletion

You can permanently remove your Asana account data, including user profile information, project details, and task history.

Google SSO

Let employees use their existing Google work account to authenticate into Asana

SAML

Connect Asana to your company's single sign-on system for centralized access control.

Frequently asked questions

How many users are included in my plan?

Asana offers flexible subscription options based on the features you need and the size of your team. For smaller teams, we have plans designed for 2 members.

How is AI Studio priced?

AI Studio is available on Starter, Advanced, Enterprise, and Enterprise+ plans. AI Studio is available in three options:

  • AI Studio Basic: Included access to AI Studio to explore how AI can help take on routine, manual work (includes rate limits).

  • AI Studio Plus: Paid access to AI Studio to level up productivity for individuals and small teams (available on monthly & annual plans).

  • AI Studio Pro: Paid access to AI Studio to scale complex workflows and business operations with advanced billing controls (available on an annual plan).

To get started, ensure your admin has Asana AI enabled. From there, all members of your domain will be able to build smart workflows. Learn more here.

How can I add people to my plan?

You can grow your team by adding seats in increments as follows:

  • Between 2 and 5 total users: add seats in increments of 1

  • Up to 30 total users: add seats in increments of 5

  • Up to 100 total users: add seats in increments of 10

  • Up to 500 total users: add seats in increments of 25

  • More than 500 users: add seats in increments of 50

How secure is Asana?

Asana is committed to protecting customer data. We build our platform using best practices for highly available, scalable, and secure cloud applications. We regularly monitor and assess our program to ensure that it meets or exceeds compliance and regulatory requirements. Please visit our Trust Center for more information.

Do you offer academic pricing?

We’re happy to work with student groups using Asana. Contact us.

Should I upgrade my organization or my team?

If you need administrators and premium package features for all teams, upgrade your entire organization. If you don't need administrators or premium features for all teams, but want to add more guests, set per-project permissions, or hide a team, you can upgrade an individual team. Learn more.

Will I be charged sales tax?

Yes. We will apply state and local sales tax based on your billing address to your total charge.

Is there an on-premises version of Asana?

We are passionate about the web and do not plan to offer an internally hosted version of Asana.

How does Asana protect my data?

Asana is committed to protecting and honoring your global privacy rights as well as securing the data you provide to us through the use of our products. For more information and details about our privacy and security programs, please visit our Trust Center.

How does Asana store my data?

The Asana subscription service is hosted on dedicated servers within secure, industry-leading data centers provided by Amazon Web Services. These data centers have achieved and maintain SOC 2 compliance and provide 24-hour physical security including biometric access controls and continuous surveillance.

Will I be charged VAT/GST?

Asana may be required to charge VAT, GST, and other taxes on your subscription in accordance with local laws and regulations. Some jurisdictions do not require VAT/GST to be charged if the purchaser is registered for VAT/GST. If you are registered for VAT or GST purposes, please add your VAT/GST registration number during the checkout process to have your exemption processed. For more information, please visit our Asana VAT Help page.

Does Asana offer a discount for nonprofits?

Asana is happy to offer eligible nonprofit organizations a discount on an Asana Starter or Asana Advanced annual plan. You can learn about the Asana nonprofit discount here.

How do I cancel my Asana subscription or trial?

To cancel a paid plan, go to the billing tab in your admin console and select Cancel plan. To find your admin console, log in to the Asana account you wish to cancel and click your profile photo in the top bar.

What is your refund policy?

We do not offer refunds. If you cancel your plan before the next renewal cycle, you will retain access to paid features until the end of your subscription period. When your subscription expires, you will lose access to paid features and all data associated with those features.
